passage.en: The classic case, of course, is the Chicago Cubs, who hadn't won the World Series for nearly a hundred years. Not only did they fail to win titles, their records were often ugly, and they'd lose any chance of the title in mid-season.

passage.zh: 但小熊隊從來不缺球迷支持者，他們的球迷甚至練就一身自我解嘲、自我安慰的本事，例如在球季開賽的第一場比賽，就高舉牌子，上面寫著：「別擔心，還有明年！」
passage.py: Dàn xiǎo xióngduì cóngláibù quē qiúmí zhīchízhě, tāmen de qiúmí shènzhì liànjiù yìshēn zìwǒjiěcháo, zìwǒānwèi de běnshì, lìrú zài qiújì kāisài de dìyìcháng bǐsài, jiù gāojǔ páizi, shàngmiàn xiězhù: “Bié dānxīn, háiyǒu míngnián!”
passage.en: But the Cubs have never lacked fans. Their fans have even developed the skill of laughing at themselves and consoling themselves—for example, at the first game of the season they hold up signs saying: "Don't worry, there's always next year!"

passage.zh: 近來台灣有不少運動員在國際體壇表現卓越，無論媒體或輿論都以「台灣之光」來稱呼這些為國爭光的運動員，一般民眾也與有榮焉，追著觀看這些台灣之光的各項賽事。

passage.zh: 不過，這些因運動員知名度提昇而追星的民眾，恐怕很難理解小熊隊球迷的忠誠，更難體會這種忠誠的價值，因為王建民、曾雅妮沒贏球，我們根本就不會注意到他們。

passage.en: But people who follow stars because athletes have become famous probably find it hard to understand the Cubs fans' loyalty, and even harder to appreciate its value—because if Wang Chien-ming and Yani Tseng hadn't won, we wouldn't have noticed them at all.

passage.zh: 我們從這些球星身上得到的，是贏的快感，是沾染贏的光榮；
passage.py: Wǒmen cóng zhèxiē qiúxīng shēnshàng dédào de, shì yíng de kuàigǎn, shì zhānrǎn yíng de Guāngróng;

passage.zh: 一旦失去了贏的因素，我們也就毫不客氣地失去對他們的興趣，轉而尋找實力更強的球隊來支持了。

image.en: Bring: the original of your national ID card, a NT$200 handling fee and a NT$275 card fee

image.zh: 申請步驟：1. 申請人攜帶本人身分證親赴申辦地點。2. 申請人填寫自然人憑證卡申請書後繳回。
image.py: Shēnqǐng bùzhòu: 1. Shēnqǐngrén xiédài běnrén shēnfènzhèng qīnfù shēnbàn dìdiǎn. 2. Shēnqǐngrén tiánxiě zìránrén píngzhèng kǎ Shēnqǐngshū hòu jiǎohuí.
image.en: Application steps: 1. The applicant goes in person to the application site with their own ID card. 2. The applicant fills in the certificate card application form and hands it in.

image.zh: 3. 承辦人員列印申請書後，請申請人確認個人資料無誤後簽名並繳回，印製憑證卡。4. 申請人取回身分證件，即完成申辦手續。
image.py: 3. Chéngbàn rényuán lièyìn Shēnqǐngshū hòu, qǐng Shēnqǐngrén quèrèn gèrénzīliào wúwù hòu qiānmíng bìng jiǎohuí, yìnzhì píngzhèng kǎ. 4. Shēnqǐngrén qǔhuí shēnfèn zhèngjiàn, jí wánchéng shēnbàn shǒuxù.
image.en: 3. The clerk prints the application; the applicant confirms the personal details are correct, signs and returns it, and the certificate card is printed. 4. The applicant takes back their ID card, and the application is complete.

image.zh: 特別注意：1. 一般來說，申辦手續約半天可完成，約兩週可領到憑證。
image.py: Tèbié zhùyì: 1. Yìbānláishuō, shēnbàn shǒuxù yuē bàntiān kě wánchéng, yuē liǎngzhōu kě lǐngdào píngzhèng.
image.en: Special notes: 1. In general the application takes about half a day, and the certificate can be collected in about two weeks.

image.zh: 2. 若卡片遺失欲重辦，得再次繳交卡片工本費（免手續費）。
image.py: 2. Ruò Kǎpiàn yíshī yù zhòngbàn, dé zàicì jiǎojiāo Kǎpiàn gōngběnfèi (Miǎn shǒuxùfèi).
image.en: 2. If the card is lost and you want a new one, you must pay the card fee again (no handling fee).

image.zh: 3. 憑證有效期限為五年，若重新辦理，應自第一次申辦起算，而非自重辦之日起算。
image.py: 3. Píngzhèng yǒuxiàoqīxiàn wèi wǔnián, ruò chóngxīn bànlǐ, yīng zì dìyícì shēnbàn qǐ suàn, ér fēi zìzhòng bàn Zhīrìqǐ suàn.
image.en: 3. The certificate is valid for five years; if reissued, validity counts from the first application, not from the date of reissue.

passage.zh: 關於風箏的起源，眾說紛紜。
passage.py: Guānyú fēngzhēng de qǐyuán, zhòngshuōfēnyún.
passage.en: There are many different accounts of the origin of the kite.

passage.zh: 宋朝陸佃認為，戰國時代的墨子已能製造可飛行三天而不會墜落的木鳶。
passage.py: Sòngcháo Lùdiàn rènwéi, zhànguóshídài de mòzi yǐ néng zhìzào kě fēixíng sāntiān ér búhuì zhuìluò de mùyuān.
passage.en: Lu Dian of the Song dynasty believed that Mozi of the Warring States period could already make a wooden hawk that flew for three days without falling.

passage.zh: 也有人認為，首先製作木鳶的應該是工匠祖師公輸班。
passage.py: Yě yǒurén rènwéi, shǒuxiān zhìzuò mùyuān de yīnggāi shì gōngjiàng zǔshī gōngshū bān.
passage.en: Others believe the first to make a wooden hawk was Gongshu Ban, the patron of craftsmen.

passage.zh: 元朝的林坤認為風箏是楚漢相爭時韓信發明的。
passage.py: Yuáncháo de línkūn rènwéi fēngzhēng shì Chǔhànxiāngzhēng shí Hánxìn fāmíng de.
passage.en: Lin Kun of the Yuan dynasty believed the kite was invented by Han Xin during the Chu–Han contention.

passage.zh: 根據正史上的記載，一千五百年前，南朝的梁武帝被侯景亂軍包圍，正在一籌莫展時，羊侃趨前獻上計策，說：「何不模仿翱翔天上的鷂鷹，製造紙鳶向外求援？」
passage.py: Gēnjù zhèngshǐ shàng de jìzǎi, yīqiānwǔbǎinián qián, náncháo de Liángwǔdì bèi Hóujǐng luànjūn bāowéi, zhèngzài yìchóumòzhǎn shí, Yángkǎn qūqián xiànshàng jìcè, shuō: “Hébù mófǎng áoxiáng tiānshàng de yàoyīng, zhìzào zhǐyuān xiàng wài qiúyuán?”
passage.en: According to the official histories, 1,500 years ago, when Emperor Wu of Liang in the Southern Dynasties was besieged by Hou Jing's rebel army and was at his wits' end, Yang Kan stepped forward with a plan: "Why not imitate the sparrowhawk soaring in the sky and make a paper hawk to seek help from outside?"

passage.zh: 中國歷史上記載的第一隻風箏於是誕生。
passage.py: Zhōngguó lìshǐ shàng jìzǎi de dìyī zhǐ fēngzhēng yúshì dànshēng.
passage.en: And so the first kite recorded in Chinese history was born.

passage.zh: 據說後來有人在紙鳶上加上竹笛，風一吹就會發出像竹箏一樣的聲響，所以叫「風箏」。
passage.py: Jùshuō hòulái yǒurén zài zhǐyuān shàng jiāshàng zhúdí, fēng yī chuī jiù huì fāchū xiàng zhúzhēng yíyàng de shēngxiǎng, suǒyǐ jiào “Fēngzhēng”.
passage.en: It is said that later someone added a bamboo flute to the paper hawk, which made a sound like a bamboo zither when the wind blew, so it was called a "fengzheng" (wind zither).

passage.py: (Sì)

passage.zh: 面臨生存危機的臺灣傳統製造業，近年來在經濟部的輔導下，正掀起一股「變身」風。
passage.py: Miànlín shēngcún wēijī de Táiwān chuántǒng zhìzàoyè, jìnniánlái zài jīngjìbù de fǔdǎo xià, zhèng xiānqǐ yìgǔ “Biàn shēn” fēng.
passage.en: Facing a survival crisis, Taiwan's traditional manufacturing industry has in recent years, with guidance from the Ministry of Economic Affairs, set off a "makeover" trend.

passage.zh: 在工廠加入觀光元素，既賣產品，也賣工廠風光，已經成為旅遊的新亮點。
passage.py: Zài gōngchǎng jiārù guānguāng yuánsù, jì mài chǎnpǐn, yě mài gōngchǎng fēngguāng, yǐjīng chéngwéi lǚyóu de xīnliàngdiǎn.
passage.en: Adding tourism to factories—selling both products and the factory scenery—has become a new travel highlight.

passage.zh: 其實這並非是一件新鮮事，如德國知名的魯爾工業區，將廢棄的鋼鐵廠交給設計師改造後，便吸引了無數遊客前往朝聖；
passage.py: Qíshí zhè bìngfēi shì yíjiàn Xīnxiānshì, rú Déguó zhīmíng de Lǔěr gōngyèqū, jiāng fèiqì de gāngtiěchǎng jiāogěi shèjìshī gǎizào hòu, biàn xīyǐn le wúshù yóukè qiánwǎng Cháoshèng;
passage.en: In fact this is nothing new. For example, Germany's famous Ruhr industrial area handed an abandoned steelworks to designers to transform, and it then attracted countless visitors on pilgrimage;

passage.zh: 又如荷蘭的台夫特陶瓷廠，是唯一以傳統手工方式生產陶瓷的工廠，90 年代也曾遭遇困境，自開放民眾親自製作陶瓷後，才又絕地逢生。
passage.py: Yòu rú Hélán de tái Fūtè táocíchǎng, shì wéiyī yǐ chuántǒng shǒugōng fāngshì shēngchǎn táocí de gōngchǎng, 90 niándài yě céng zāoyù kùnjìng, zì kāifàng mínzhòng qīnzì zhìzuò táocí hòu, cái yòu juédì féngshēng.
passage.en: another example is the Delft pottery factory in the Netherlands, the only factory producing ceramics by traditional handcraft. It ran into difficulties in the 1990s and only came back from the brink after letting the public make ceramics themselves.

passage.zh: 而臺灣的觀光工廠現今也正朝「看得到、吃得到、玩得到、買得到」的方向發展，只可惜目前工廠的英語導覽能力不足，因此仍未能與國際觀光接軌，現階段客源主要靠國民旅遊支撐。
passage.py: Ér Táiwān de guānguāng gōngchǎng xiànjīn yě zhèng cháo “Kàn dédào, chī dédào, wán dédào, mǎi dédào” de fāngxiàng fāzhǎn, zhǐ kěxī mùqián gōngchǎng de Yīngyǔ dǎolǎn nénglì bùzú, yīncǐ réng wèinéng yǔ guójì guānguāng jiēguǐ, xiànjiēduàn kèyuán zhǔyào kào guómín lǚyóu zhīchēng.
passage.en: Taiwan's tourist factories are now also developing in the direction of "things to see, eat, play and buy," but unfortunately the factories' English guiding ability is currently inadequate, so they still can't connect with international tourism; at this stage visitors come mainly from domestic tourism.

passage.zh: 另一方面，對經營者來說，更大的難題是以前工廠假日休息，而國民旅遊潮卻多出現在假日。
passage.py: Lìngyìfāngmiàn, duì jīngyíngzhě láishuō, gèng dà de nántí shì yǐqián gōngchǎng jiàrì xiūxí, ér guómín lǚyóu cháo què duō chūxiàn zài jiàrì.
passage.en: On the other hand, for operators the bigger problem is that factories used to close on holidays, while domestic tourism peaks on holidays.

passage.zh: 要參觀生產過程，員工就得加班，並且還得穿著整齊、動作專業，以往邊工作邊說話的習慣都要「收」起來，員工反彈在所難免。
passage.py: Yào cānguān shēngchǎn guòchéng, yuángōng jiù dé jiābān, bìngqiě hái dé chuānzhù zhěngqí, dòngzuò zhuānyè, yǐwǎng biān gōngzuò biān shuōhuà de xíguàn dōu yào “Shōu” qǐlái, yuángōng fǎntán zàisuǒnánmiǎn.
passage.en: For visitors to see the production process, employees have to work overtime, and also dress neatly and move professionally; the old habit of chatting while working has to be "put away," so employee resistance is inevitable.

passage.zh: 再說，有些經營者無法接受下一代在快沒飯吃的情況下，還打算花大錢裝潢、設計觀光動線、培訓解說人員，而這些為品牌加分的經濟效果並不是立即可見的，於是兩代之間衝突不斷，也常見第二代因此被掃地出門，只好另立品牌的例子。
passage.py: Zàishuō, yǒuxiē jīngyíngzhě wúfǎ jiēshòu xiàyídài zài kuài méifàn chī de qíngkuàng xià, hái dǎsuàn Huādàqián zhuānghuáng, shèjì guānguāng dòngxiàn, péixùn jiěshuō rényuán, ér zhèxiē wèi pǐnpái jiāfēn de jīngjì xiàoguǒ bìng búshì lìjí kějiàn de, yúshì liǎngdài zhījiān chōngtū búduàn, yě chángjiàn dìèrdài yīncǐ bèi sǎodìchūmén, zhǐhǎo lìng lì pǐnpái de lìzi.
passage.en: Moreover, some operators can't accept that the next generation, when they're almost out of money, still plan to spend heavily on renovation, designing tourist routes and training guides—and the brand-boosting economic effects of these aren't immediately visible. So there is constant conflict between the two generations, and it's common for the second generation to be kicked out as a result and have to set up their own brand.

passage.zh: 臺灣的觀光工廠雖然尚未成熟，但當遊客置身在這些傳統工廠裡，除了觀光、學習外，彷彿也進入了時光隧道，重溫數十年前以「臺灣製造」創下經濟奇蹟的故事，並且藉著參觀和購買行為，和業者一同創造新一波的經濟奇蹟。
passage.py: Táiwān de guānguāng gōngchǎng suīrán shàngwèi chéngshú, dàn dāng yóukè zhìshēn zài zhèxiē chuántǒng gōngchǎng lǐ, chúle guānguāng, xuéxí wài, fǎngfú yě jìnrù le shíguāngsuìdào, chóngwēn shùshínián qiányǐ “Táiwān zhìzào” chuàngxià jīngjì qíjì de gùshì, bìngqiě jí zhù cānguān hé gòumǎi xíngwéi, hé yèzhě yìtóng chuàngzào Xīnyìbō de jīngjì qíjì.
passage.en: Although Taiwan's tourist factories are not yet mature, when visitors are inside these traditional factories, besides sightseeing and learning, they seem to enter a time tunnel, reliving the story of the economic miracle created by "Made in Taiwan" decades ago, and through visiting and buying they create a new wave of economic miracle together with the businesses.

passage.zh: 從這個角度來看，也算得上是好事一樁。
passage.py: Cóng zhè ge jiǎodù láikàn, yě suàn dé shàng shì hǎoshì yìzhuāng.
passage.en: From this perspective, it can be counted as a good thing.

D.py: Cānkǎo Wàiguó de zuòfǎ cái yǒu jīhuì chénggōng
D.en: (D) They can only succeed by following foreign practices.

passage.py: (Wǔ)

passage.zh: 未來的道路收費的方式可能和目前的制度大不相同。
passage.py: Wèilái de dàolù shōufèi de fāngshì kěnéng hé mùqián de zhìdù dàbùxiāngtóng.
passage.en: Road charges in the future may be very different from the current system.

passage.zh: 在 GPS 等無線定位技術問世後，我們便能精確地計算開車成本和道路價值，一個嶄新的交通觀念於是產生：讓駕駛人依據實際開車的里程數來支付道路費用。
passage.py: Zài GPS děng wúxiàn dìngwèi jìshù wènshì hòu, wǒmen biàn néng jīngquè dì jìsuàn kāichē chéngběn hé dàolù jiàzhí, yí ge zhǎnxīn de jiāotōng guānniàn yúshì chǎnshēng: Ràng jiàshǐ rén yījù shíjì kāichē de lǐchéng shù lái zhīfù dàolù fèiyòng.
passage.en: Since wireless positioning technologies such as GPS appeared, we can precisely calculate the cost of driving and the value of roads, and so a brand-new transport concept has emerged: letting drivers pay road charges according to the actual distance they drive.

passage.zh: 專家們相信，這樣的做法能有效改善塞車問題，以及降低意外事故。
passage.py: Zhuānjiā men xiāngxìn, zhèyàng de zuòfǎ néng yǒuxiào gǎishàn Sāichē wèntí, yǐjí jiàngdī yìwàishìgù.
passage.en: Experts believe this approach can effectively ease traffic congestion and reduce accidents.

passage.zh: 目前多數國家的道路費用是透過汽車牌照稅、燃料稅等等來徵收。
passage.py: Mùqián duōshù guójiā de dàolù fèiyòng shì tòuguò qìchē páizhàoshuì, ránliào shuì děngděng lái zhēngshōu.
passage.en: At present, most countries collect road charges through vehicle license taxes, fuel taxes and so on.

passage.zh: 駕駛人無論是使用擁擠或是空曠的道路，所支付的費用相同；
passage.py: Jiàshǐ rén wúlùnshì shǐyòng yōngjǐ huòshì Kōngkuàng de dàolù, suǒ zhīfù de fèiyòng xiāngtóng;
passage.en: Whether drivers use congested or empty roads, they pay the same;

passage.zh: 一個月只開一次車的人所支付的費用，也跟每天開車的人一樣，說起來並不是很合理。
passage.py: Yígeyuè zhǐ kāi yícì chē de rén suǒ zhīfù de fèiyòng, yě gēn měitiān kāichē de rén yíyàng, shuō qǐlái bìng búshì hěn hélǐ.
passage.en: someone who drives only once a month pays the same as someone who drives every day, which isn't very reasonable.

passage.zh: 近來荷蘭政府推動一項實驗，依照駕駛人實際開車的里程來收費，而且，流量越高的道路，收費也越高。
passage.py: Jìnlái Hélánzhèngfǔ tuīdòng yíxiàng shíyàn, yīzhào jiàshǐ rén shíjì kāichē de lǐchéng lái shōufèi, érqiě, liúliàng yuè gāo de dàolù, shōufèi yě yuè gāo.
passage.en: Recently the Dutch government ran an experiment charging drivers according to the actual distance driven, and the busier the road, the higher the charge.

passage.zh: 實驗顯示，計畫實施後，有高達七成的駕駛人選擇在離峰時間上路、或避開擁擠的路段，有效改善市區交通。
passage.py: Shíyàn xiǎnshì, jìhuà shíshī hòu, yǒu gāo dá qīchéng de jiàshǐ rén xuǎnzé zài lífēng shíjiān Shànglù, huò bìkāi yōngjǐ de lùduàn, yǒuxiào gǎishàn shìqū jiāotōng.
passage.en: The experiment showed that after the plan was implemented, as many as 70% of drivers chose to travel at off-peak times or avoid congested roads, effectively improving city traffic.

passage.zh: 按里程收費對環保也有助益。
passage.py: Àn lǐchéng shōufèi duì huánbǎo yě yǒu zhùyì.
passage.en: Charging by distance also helps the environment.

passage.zh: 在德國，大貨車的計費標準不只是里程，還包括了廢氣排放量，污染越嚴重的貨車得支付越高的里程費。
passage.py: Zài Déguó, dà huòchē de jìfèi biāozhǔn bù zhǐshì lǐchéng, hái bāokuò le fèiqì páifàngliàng, wūrǎn yuè yánzhòng de huòchē dé zhīfù yuè gāo de lǐchéng fèi.
passage.en: In Germany, trucks are charged not only by distance but also by emissions; the more polluting the truck, the higher the distance fee.

passage.zh: 按里程收費實施之後，高污染貨車的行駛次數便大幅減少。
passage.py: Àn lǐchéng shōufèi shíshī zhīhòu, gāowūrǎn huòchē de xíngshǐ cìshù biàn dàfú jiǎnshǎo.
passage.en: After distance-based charging was introduced, the number of trips by high-polluting trucks fell sharply.

passage.zh: 可惜這類計畫雖然有效，所費卻不貲。
passage.py: Kěxī zhè lèi jìhuà suīrán yǒuxiào, suǒfèi què bùzī.
passage.en: Unfortunately, although such plans are effective, they are very expensive.

passage.zh: 一家英國保險公司在客戶車上加裝記錄器，仔細記錄駕駛人的行車速度、距離及駕駛方式，再根據這些紀錄為不同客戶設定保險費。
passage.py: Yìjiā Yīngguó bǎoxiǎngōngsī zài kèhù chēshàng jiāzhuāng jìlùqì, zǐxì jìlù jiàshǐ rén de xíngchē sùdù, jùlí jí jiàshǐ fāngshì, zài gēnjù zhèxiē jìlù wèi bùtóng kèhù shèdìng bǎoxiǎnfèi.
passage.en: A British insurance company installed recorders in customers' cars, carefully recording drivers' speed, distance and driving style, and then set premiums for different customers based on these records.

passage.zh: 經常開車或習慣開快車的駕駛人，得多付一點兒保險金。
passage.py: Jīngcháng kāichē huò xíguàn kāikuàichē de jiàshǐ rén, dé duōfù yìdiǎnér bǎoxiǎnjīn.
passage.en: Drivers who drove often or habitually drove fast had to pay a bit more.

passage.zh: 儘管這個措施很有效，實施期間，保險公司的意外理賠因此少了 30%，但由於記錄器過於昂貴，這項計畫到最後還是不了了之。
passage.py: Jǐnguǎn zhè ge cuòshī hěn yǒuxiào, shíshī qījiān, bǎoxiǎngōngsī de yìwài lǐpéi yīncǐ shǎo le 30 %, dàn yóuyú jìlùqì guòyú ángguì, zhèxiàng jìhuà dào zuìhòu háishì bùliǎoliǎozhī.
passage.en: Although the measure was very effective—during the trial the insurer's accident claims fell by 30%—because the recorders were too expensive, the plan eventually fizzled out.

stem.py: Gēnjù dìèrduàn, mùqián zhēngshōu de dàolù fèiyòng yǒu shénme bùhélǐ de dìfāng?

passage.py: (Liù)

passage.zh: 主計處報告指出，今年台灣的失業率跌破 5%，但非典型就業人數卻逐年上升，今年達 72.3 萬人，創歷史新高。
passage.py: Zhǔjìchù bàogào zhǐchū, jīnnián Táiwān de shīyèlǜ diēpò 5 %, dàn fēidiǎnxíng jiùyèrénshù què zhúnián shàngshēng, jīnnián dá 72.3 wàn rén, chuàng lìshǐ xīngāo.
passage.en: A report by the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics shows that Taiwan's unemployment rate fell below 5% this year, but the number of people in atypical employment has risen year after year, reaching 723,000 this year—a record high.

passage.zh: 國內十五至廿四歲勞動人口中，非典型就業者約占 25％，居各年齡層之冠，有年輕化跡象。
passage.py: Guónèi shíwǔ zhì niànsìsuì láodòng rénkǒu zhōng, fēidiǎnxíng jiùyèzhě yuē zhàn 25 ％, jū gè niánlíngcéng zhī guān, yǒu niánqīnghuà jìxiàng.
passage.en: Among workers aged 15 to 24 in Taiwan, about 25% are in atypical employment, the highest of any age group, showing a trend toward younger workers.

passage.zh: 大專以上就業者中，每一百人中約六人是非典型工作者，也呈上升態勢。
passage.py: Dàzhuān yǐshàng jiùyèzhě zhōng, měi yìbǎi rén zhōng yuē liù rén shìfēi diǎnxíng gōngzuòzhě, yě chéngshàngshēng tàishì.
passage.en: Among employed people with a college education or above, about six in every hundred are atypical workers, also on the rise.

passage.zh: 所謂「非典型就業者」，是指企業為節省人力成本，聘僱非正式的員工，包括打工族、工讀生、臨時工、兼職人員等等。
passage.py: Suǒwèi “Fēidiǎnxíng jiùyèzhě”, shì zhǐ qǐyè wèi jiéshěng rénlì chéngběn, pìngù fēizhèngshì de yuángōng, bāokuò Dǎgōngzú, gōngdúshēng, línshígōng, jiānzhí rényuán děngděng.
passage.en: "Atypical workers" are informal employees hired by companies to save labor costs, including casual workers, working students, temporary workers, part-timers and so on.

passage.zh: 過去，台灣非典型就業的人口多半集中在中高齡、低學歷、二度就業等弱勢族群，然而近年來，非典型就業人口的年齡層卻不斷下降。
passage.py: Guòqù, Táiwān fēidiǎnxíng jiùyè de rénkǒu duōbàn jízhōng zài Zhōng gāolíng, dī xuélì, èrdù jiùyè děng ruòshì zúqún, ránér jìnniánlái, fēidiǎnxíng jiùyèrénkǒu de niánlíngcéng què búduàn xiàjiàng.
passage.en: In the past, Taiwan's atypical workers were mostly concentrated in disadvantaged groups such as the middle-aged and elderly, the less educated and people returning to work, but in recent years the age of atypical workers has kept falling.

passage.zh: 美國《商業周刊》指出，後金融海嘯時代來臨，以臨時工作人員取代正職的作法在美國企業蔚為風尚，先前歷經大裁員的企業尤其熱中此道，不願釋出正式職缺。
passage.py: Měiguó «Shāngyè zhōukān» zhǐchū, hòu jīnróng hǎixiào shídài láilín, yǐ línshí gōngzuòrényuán qǔdài zhèngzhí de zuòfǎ zài Měiguó qǐyè Wèiwèi fēngshàng, xiānqián lìjīng dà cáiyuán de qǐyè yóuqí rè zhōng cǐ dào, bù yuàn shìchū zhèngshì zhí quē.
passage.en: The American magazine BusinessWeek points out that with the arrival of the post-financial-tsunami era, replacing full-time staff with temporary workers has become fashionable among American companies; companies that previously went through mass layoffs are especially keen on it and unwilling to open full-time positions.

passage.zh: 在此潮流下受害最深者，莫過於剛從學校畢業、找尋人生第一份工作的新鮮人。
passage.py: Zài cǐ cháoliú xià shòuhài zuìshēn zhě, mòguòyú gāng cóng xuéxiào bìyè, zhǎoxún rénshēng dìyífèn gōngzuò de Xīnxiān rén.
passage.en: Those hurt most by this trend are none other than new graduates fresh out of school looking for their first job.

passage.zh: 最近十年，亞洲國家的「非典型僱用潮」亦儼然成形。
passage.py: Zuìjìn shínián, Yàzhōu guójiā de “Fēidiǎnxíng gùyòng cháo” yì yǎnrán chéngxíng.
passage.en: In the last ten years, a "wave of atypical employment" has clearly taken shape in Asian countries too.

passage.zh: 在日本，非典型就業人口於 1990 年占總就業人數的 20％，2007 年已升至 34％；
passage.py: Zài Rìběn, fēidiǎnxíng jiùyèrénkǒu yú 1990 nián zhàn zǒng jiùyèrénshù de 20 ％, 2007 nián yǐ shēngzhì 34 ％;
passage.en: In Japan, atypical workers made up 20% of total employment in 1990 and had risen to 34% by 2007;

passage.zh: 韓國 2008 年突破 44％後，2009 年上揚至 50％左右。
passage.py: Hánguó 2008 nián tūpò 44 ％ hòu, 2009 nián shàngyáng zhì 50 ％ zuǒyòu.
passage.en: in South Korea, after passing 44% in 2008, it rose to around 50% in 2009.

passage.zh: 台灣也難逃此趨勢，非典型就業人數呈現逐年遞增的情況。
passage.py: Táiwān yě nántáo cǐ qūshì, fēidiǎnxíng jiùyèrénshù chéngxiàn zhúnián dìzēng de qíngkuàng.
passage.en: Taiwan can't escape this trend either: the number of atypical workers is increasing year by year.

passage.zh: 報告也指出，今年營造業的非典型勞工為 12.7 萬人，約占總員工數的 16％，不論是人數或比例均拔得頭籌。
passage.py: Bàogào yě zhǐchū, jīnnián yíngzàoyè de fēidiǎnxíng láogōng wèi 12.7 wàn rén, yuē zhàn zǒng yuángōng shù de 16 ％, búlùnshì rénshù huò bǐlì jūn bá dé tóuchóu.
passage.en: The report also notes that this year the construction industry had 127,000 atypical workers, about 16% of its total workforce—first in both number and proportion.

passage.zh: 這是因為營造業以勞力為主的職缺多、替代性高，業者愈來愈傾向僱用臨時、短期工的緣故。
passage.py: Zhè shìyīnwèi yíngzàoyè yǐ láolì wéizhǔ de zhíquē duō, tìdàixìng gāo, yèzhě yùláiyù qīngxiàng gùyòng línshí, duǎnqī gōng de yuángù.
passage.en: This is because construction has many labor-based jobs that are easily replaced, so businesses increasingly tend to hire temporary and short-term workers.

passage.zh: 早期時尚的開端，始自金字塔尖端的消費者，設計師卯足全力為上流社會的權貴們，設計各種不同場合的服裝。
passage.py: Zǎoqī shíshàng de kāiduān, shǐzì Jīnzìtǎ jiānduān de xiāofèizhě, shèjìshī mǎozú quánlì wèi Shàngliúshèhuì de Quánguì men, shèjì gèzhǒng bùtóng chǎnghé de fúzhuāng.
passage.en: Fashion in its early days started from consumers at the top of the pyramid: designers went all out designing clothes for every occasion for the powerful members of high society.

passage.zh: 這些典雅細緻的貴族風格，主導了當時的流行趨勢。
passage.py: Zhèxiē diǎnyǎ xìzhì de guìzú fēnggé, zhǔdǎo le dāngshí de liúxíng qūshì.
passage.en: These elegant, refined aristocratic styles led the fashion trends of the time.

passage.zh: 不過，到了 50、60 年代，那些以青少年為代表的街頭文化，反而以革命之姿創造新的時代風格。
passage.py: Búguò, dào le 50, 60 niándài, nàxiē yǐ Qīngshàonián wèi dàibiǎo de jiētóu wénhuà, fǎnér yǐ gémìng zhī zī chuàngzào xīn de shídài fēnggé.
passage.en: But in the 1950s and 60s, street culture, represented by teenagers, instead created a new era's style in revolutionary fashion.

passage.zh: 當時的年輕族群聚集街頭、彈著樂器、穿著怪異的服飾、無視他人質疑的眼光，發展出極富生命力的文化。
passage.py: Dāngshí de niánqīng zúqún jùjí jiētóu, dànzhù yuèqì, chuānzhù guàiyì de fúshì, wúshì tārén zhìyí de yǎnguāng, fāzhǎn chū jífù shēngmìnglì de wénhuà.
passage.en: Young people at the time gathered on the streets, playing instruments and wearing outlandish clothes, ignoring the questioning looks of others, and developed a culture full of vitality.

passage.zh: 從嬉皮、龐克、搖滾到嘻哈，每一種潮流都勇於反叛、挑戰權威，既獨特又充滿原創力，讓那些原本緊抓著上流時尚與精緻工藝的設計師們，也不得不低頭，從這群充滿創意的街頭青少年身上擷取靈感。
passage.py: Cóng xīpí, Pángkè, yáogǔn dào xī hā, měi yìzhǒng cháoliú dōu yǒngyú fǎnpàn, tiǎozhàn Quánwēi, jì dútè yòu chōngmǎn yuánchuàng lì, ràng nàxiē yuánběn jǐnzhuā zhù shàngliú shíshàng yǔ jīngzhì gōngyì de shèjìshī men, yě bùdébù dītóu, cóng zhè qún chōngmǎn chuàngyì de jiētóu Qīngshàonián shēnshàng xiéqǔ línggǎn.
passage.en: From hippies, punk and rock to hip-hop, every trend dared to rebel and challenge authority, unique and full of originality, so that even designers who had clung to high-society fashion and fine craftsmanship had to bow their heads and draw inspiration from these creative street teenagers.

passage.zh: I
passage.py: I
passage.en: I

passage.zh: 可惜，那樣充滿叛逆的時代已然遠去。
passage.py: Kěxī, nàyàng chōngmǎn pànnì de shídài yǐrán yuǎnqù.
passage.en: Sadly, that rebellious era is long gone.

passage.zh: 反觀現在的年輕族群，穿搭的主軸不是來自原創，而是向奢華靠攏。
passage.py: Fǎnguān xiànzài de niánqīng zúqún, chuān dā de zhǔzhóu búshì láizì yuánchuàng, érshì xiàng shēhuá kàolǒng.
passage.en: By contrast, the main thread in how today's young people dress comes not from originality but from leaning toward luxury.

passage.zh: II 殊不知他們的價值觀和創造力已被所謂的精品名牌給吞噬了。
passage.py: II shūbùzhī tāmen de jiàzhíguān hé chuàngzàolì yǐ bèi suǒwèi de jīngpǐn míngpái gěi tūnshì le.
passage.en: II Little do they know that their values and creativity have been swallowed up by so-called luxury brands.

passage.zh: 在我看來， III 人在年輕時期總有許多稀奇古怪的想法，加上同儕之間的相互刺激，許多創意與點子應該在這個時期盡情展現。
passage.py: Zàiwǒkànlái, III rén zài niánqīng shíqī zǒng yǒu xǔduō xīqígǔguài de xiǎngfǎ, jiāshàng tóngchái zhījiān de xiānghù cìjī, xǔduō chuàngyì yǔ diǎnzi yīnggāi zài zhè ge shíqī jìnqíng zhǎnxiàn.
passage.en: In my view, III people always have many strange and wonderful ideas when young, and with peers stimulating each other, many creative ideas should be fully expressed at this stage.

passage.zh: 如果，在這個階段的青少年只知盲目追逐大人世界的頂級名牌，那將會扼殺多少創意？
passage.py: Rúguǒ, zài zhè ge jiēduàn de Qīngshàonián zhǐ zhī mángmù zhuīzhú dàrén shìjiè de dǐngjí míngpái, nà jiāng huì èshā duōshǎo chuàngyì?
passage.en: If teenagers at this stage only blindly chase the top brands of the adult world, how much creativity will be stifled?

passage.zh: IV 下一次，當你看到青少年們頂著五彩頭髮、穿著從未見過的怪異服裝，請不要制止，或許，他們將引領出另一波劃時代的時尚風潮。
passage.py: IV xià yícì, dāng nǐ kàndào Qīngshàonián men dǐngzhù Wǔcǎi tóufà, chuānzhù cóngwèijiànguò de guàiyì fúzhuāng, qǐng búyào zhìzhǐ, huòxǔ, tāmen jiāng yǐnlǐng chū lìng yī Bō huàshídài de shíshàng fēngcháo.
passage.en: IV Next time you see teenagers with rainbow-colored hair and strange clothes you've never seen before, please don't stop them—perhaps they will lead another epoch-making fashion trend.
